bots.name: Sunny Gold
bots.strategy: Follows gold's trend on 1-hour candles: buys when the 20-hour average crosses above the 50-hour average, sells short on the opposite cross, with a safety stop. Paper test on live gold prices since 2026-09-24; 2 more gold setups are tested alongside it, and the best one takes over.

bots.name: Sunny Gold Fast
bots.strategy: Checks gold every 5 minutes. Trades a 15-minute trend turn, but only in the same direction as gold's big 60-day trend, with a safety stop. An experiment on a separate $1,000 of practice money: in testing, trading this fast lost money, so watch it, don't trust it yet.
